column1: # The object ids a house scan matches for each built feature, one per frame or skin, with
# RuneLite's ObjectID constant for each id in the column after, in the same order, and the
# scanner that looks for it. Each scan records its scanner, the highest number here, so a
# scan proves a feature missing only when its scanner looked for that feature. A scanner looks
# for every feature numbered at or below its own, with every id listed here.
# The Troll Stronghold portal is not the Trollheim portal, which lands on the mountain east
# of the stronghold. The spiritual fairy tree (POH_SPIRIT_RING and its skins) counts as both
# a spirit tree and a fairy ring.
# Each jewellery box tier spawns one id. The mounted Xeric's talisman and digsite pendant
# spawn one id per left-click destination, plus a base id; the mounts and the glory are wall
